primary.title: Opening an account takes two or more visits
primary.problem: Customers arrive without the right documents and are asked to come back. Some never return.
primary.why: Lost new accounts and repeat queue time at busy lounges.

backup.title: Customers don't know they can freeze or limit their card in the app
backup.problem: Card-related calls and visits for things the app already does.
backup.why: Avoidable visits; low use of self-service features.

primary.title: Many customers start mobile banking registration but never finish it
primary.problem: Registration drops off at device verification and OTP steps.
primary.why: Lower digital adoption keeps routine transactions in the lounge.

backup.title: No follow-up after a customer enquires about a product
backup.problem: Enquiries aren't logged, so interested customers are never contacted again.

primary.title: Loan applicants can't see where their application stands
primary.problem: Applicants call or visit repeatedly to ask for status updates.
primary.why: Staff time lost to status calls; poor customer experience.

backup.title: Atoll customers travel to Malé for tasks that could be done remotely
backup.problem: Some requests still need an in-person signature or visit.
backup.why: Travel cost and time for customers; lost goodwill.

primary.title: KYC refresh means customers must visit in person
primary.problem: Accounts get restricted when KYC expires, and updating needs a visit.
primary.why: Restricted accounts frustrate customers and add walk-ins.

backup.title: Complaints are tracked on paper and spreadsheets
backup.problem: No single view of open complaints or how long they have been open.

primary.title: Account opening needs multiple visits for missing documents
primary.problem: Customers are turned away for one missing document.
primary.why: Drop-off before the account is opened.

backup.title: Staff can't easily see which products a customer already holds
backup.problem: Cross-sell conversations start without a clear product view.
backup.why: Missed cross-sell and repeated questions to customers.

primary.title: Customers wait in the lounge queue for simple requests
primary.problem: Statement, PIN and card requests take a queue ticket like everything else.
primary.why: Long waits put off customers who came for advice or a sale.

backup.title: Merchant QR payments are rarely offered to small shops
backup.problem: Sales staff do not bring up merchant payments in conversations.

canvases.title: Ready Before You Arrive
canvases.approach: Send a document checklist by SMS and Viber the moment a customer books or enquires, with a one-tap pre-check of their ID.
canvases.impl: Template messages in 2 weeks; pilot in two Malé lounges for a month; Products & Projects owns the rollout.
canvases.benefits: Target: most new accounts opened in one visit; fewer repeat queue tickets at peak hours.

canvases.title: Finish the Sign-up
canvases.approach: Staff complete mobile banking registration with the customer at the desk, and the app sends a reminder if a registration is left half-done.
canvases.impl: Desk checklist now; reminder message with the digital team in Q1; weekly drop-off report by lounge.
canvases.benefits: More active app users and fewer routine walk-ins.

canvases.title: Track My Loan
canvases.approach: Automatic status messages at each loan stage: received, under review, approved, ready to sign.
canvases.impl: Map the five stages with Credit; trigger SMS from the existing loan workflow; pilot on personal loans.
canvases.benefits: Fewer status calls to lounges and credit; better customer experience scores.

canvases.title: KYC From Home
canvases.approach: Let customers refresh KYC in the app with an ID photo and selfie, reviewed by a back-office team.
canvases.impl: Agree requirements with Compliance; build on existing app onboarding; restricted accounts get an in-app prompt first.
canvases.benefits: Fewer restricted accounts and walk-ins; staff time freed for sales and advice.

canvases.title: Know Your Customer at a Glance
canvases.approach: A one-page customer product view for lounge staff with suggested next products.
canvases.impl: Use existing core data; start as a read-only screen; train advisors in one session.
canvases.benefits: More cross-sell conversations and a better conversion rate per visit.

canvases.title: Fast Lane
canvases.approach: A self-service kiosk and a separate quick-service desk for statements, PIN and card requests.
canvases.impl: Pilot one kiosk at the busiest lounge; redirect simple ticket types; review after six weeks.
canvases.benefits: Shorter queues and more advisor time for sales conversations.
